content: Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari kemɨtiuwewiya

'Etsekiyaxi niuki kaneutanɨ'axɨani naitsarie 'ixaheritsixi teɨteriyari wahetsɨa meta Kuratsie kiekatari, metatsiere nuiwarite 'Epɨrahinitsie miemete meta Manatsexi nuiwarimama, Yawé tukieya manuwe memɨyukuxeɨrienikɨ Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari memɨwewienikɨ Yawé 'Ixaheri Kakaɨyarieya hetsiemieme.
Ti'aitame, meta teɨteri wa'ukiyarima meta yunaitɨ teɨteri, mɨpaɨ mepɨte'uxatakai kename Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari mewewienikekai hutarieka metseritsie.
Peru mepɨka'uyɨwekaxɨa mɨkɨ tukaritsie yumɨiretɨ 'akuxi mawari wewiwamete memɨkayu'itiwawekaikɨ, meta teɨteri Kerutsareme memɨkayukuxeɨriwawekaikɨ.
Kememɨte'uxa ti'aitame meta yunaitɨ teɨteri muwarunakixɨkɨ,

yamekateniuxata naitsarie 'Ixaheritsie mɨpaɨ memɨtekaxatɨarienikɨ, Rani kiekariyaritsie me'itsutɨame 'atsita Weritsewa paitɨ, yunaitɨ meke'uyukuxeɨrienike Kerutsaremetsie Yawé hetsiemieme Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari memɨwewienikɨ, 'Ixaheri Kakaɨyarieya, mɨixa panuyemiekairi memɨka'iwewiwawekai kemɨre'uxa.

Hikɨ naitsarie 'Ixaheritsie meta Kuratsie mekaneutayeixɨani niuki tuayamete ti'aitame meta 'iparewiwametemama waxapate me'uhurietɨ, kemɨra'aitakai ti'aitame mɨpaɨ meteniwakuxaxatɨwakaitɨni: «'Ixaheritsixi teɨteriyari, Yawé hetsɨa xekeneu'axɨa, 'Apɨrahami, 'Itsahaki meta 'Ixaheri wakakaɨyari, mɨkɨta xehetsɨa munuanikɨ xeme xemuyuhayewaxɨ, 'Atsiriyatsie te'aitamete wahetsɨa xemutawikwei.
Xe'ukiyarima wahepaɨ xepɨka'aneni, meta yu'iwama wahepaɨ, Yawé memuku'eiri me'eye'unietɨ memakɨ, yu'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari. 'Ayumieme mɨkɨ xeme nanaimariwamete kanixe'ayeitɨani, hikɨ kexemɨteneniere.

Yu'iyaritsie xetsetse'itɨ xepɨkahayuyeitɨaka, xe'ukiyarima wahepaɨ. Yawé hetsɨa xekeneyuyetua, meta tukitana xekeneutahaxɨa, mɨkɨ patsiekame mayeitɨa yuheyemekɨ. Yawé yukakaɨyari xekenayexeiyani, ha'atɨ mɨtihayewakɨ xehepaɨtsita.

Yawé hetsɨa xɨka xe'u'axɨani, xe'iwama meta xeniwema memɨwarehapa mepɨwaretinenimayata, hikɨ memanuaxɨani 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie mepeyɨwekaxɨani. Yawé xekakaɨyari pɨtiuyukanenimaya meta mɨreuyehɨwirieni pɨyɨwe. Xɨka xeme ta'aurie xehaxɨrieni hetsɨana xe'u'axɨani, mɨkɨ hatsuaku pɨkaxeku'eirieni».
Hikɨ niuki tuayamete mekaneutayeixɨani naitsarie 'Epɨrahini meta Manatsexi kiekariteyaritsie, 'atsita Tsawuruni paitɨ mekaniye'axɨani, peru yunaitɨ mekaniutinawekaitɨni meta mekaniwananaimakaitɨni.
Matsi, hipatɨ 'Atsexi nuiwarimama, Manatsexi meta Tsawuruni wanuiwarima tixaɨ mekatehayuyeitɨaka mekanekɨne Kerutsaremetsie.
Metatsiere Kuratsie kiekatari, Kakaɨyari waruyuitɨaku, yamekatenikakɨne meyuxewitɨ ti'aitame kemɨra'aitakai meta teɨteri wa'ukiyarima, Yawé niukieya kemainekai.
Hikɨ hutarieka metseritsie, Kerutsaremetsie mekaniuyukuxeɨrieni yumɨiretɨ teɨteri Paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka 'ixɨarariyari memɨwewienikɨ.
Kerutsareme kiekariyaritsie mawari taiyame kakaɨyarixi mɨwahetsiemiemetɨkai mekaniuti'una meta 'ɨkwa taiyamete, hikɨ Kiruni 'akiyaritsie mekateneukaxɨrieni.

Hutarieka metseriyaritsie tamamata heimana nauka tukariyaritsie, Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyari mekaniuwewieni. Mawari wewiwamete meta rewitsixi mekaniyutitetewiya, 'ayumieme mekaniuyu'itieni meta mawari taiyariyari mekaniuwewieni Yawé tukieya manuwe,

hikɨ 'arike mɨyamete'uyurieka kememɨte'uximayakai mɨpaɨ mekateniu'uni, kemaine 'inɨari niukiyari Muitsexi kemɨraka'utɨa, tewi Kakaɨyari hetsɨa mieme. Rewitsixi mawari wewiwamete xuriya mekaniwayetuiriwakaitɨni, mɨkɨta mawari taiyame mekanikɨ'ɨyakaitɨni.
Yumɨiretɨ teɨteri memɨkayu'itiwawekaikɨ 'akuxi, Yawé hetsiemieme memɨpatsienikɨ muxatsi Patsikwa 'ixɨarariyaritsie miemete rewitsixi mekaniwarukwini wahetsiemieme.

Yumɨiretɨ teɨteri 'Epɨrahinitsie, Manatsexitsie, 'Itsakaxitsie meta Tsawurunitsie memeyekɨ Patsikwa mekaniukwani mekayu'itieka, kemainekai 'aitsika yamekatekakɨneka. Peru 'Etsekiyaxi mɨpaɨ katiniuyunenewieni wahetsiemieme: «Ketiniwareuyehɨwiri, Kakaɨyari 'aixɨa pemɨtiuka'iyari,
kemɨ'ane memɨyuwaɨri yu'iyarikɨ Yawé 'ahetsie memɨtewiyanikɨ, wa'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari, tsepa mɨkayu'iti 'a'aitsika kemaine 'itiya hepaɨtsita mɨtikuxata».
Hikɨ Yawé 'Etsekiyaxi kaniu'enieni meta teɨteri katiniwareuyehɨwirieni.

Hikɨ 'ixaheritsixi Kerutsareme memu'uwakai waɨkawa meyutemamawietɨ Paa mɨkakuxanariyarietɨka 'ixɨarariyari mepɨwewiekai, 'atahuta tukari mepuyuri. Rewitsixi meta mawari wewiwamete Yawé mepɨnɨawakai xexuime tukaritsie, meputikwikakai meteyuitɨatɨ.

'Etsekiyaxi rewitsixi kaniwarutawaɨritɨani Yawé hetsiemieme mete'uximayatɨ memayuti'uitɨakai. 'Atahuta tukari 'ixɨarari mekaniuwewieni meta patsikwa 'ikwaiyari mekanikwakaitɨni, memuyuxewinikɨ mawariyari mewewietɨ meta Yawé menɨawatɨ, yu'ukiyarima wakakaɨyari.
Merikɨte yunaitɨ teɨteri me'uyu'enieka yamekateniuxata tawarita 'atahuta tukari 'ixɨarari memɨwewienikɨ, hikɨ mɨkɨ waɨkawa meyutemamawietɨ 'ixɨarari mekaniuwewieni mɨkɨ 'atahuta tukari.

Hikɨ Kura kwieyaritsie ti'aitame 'Etsekiyaxi, teɨteri memɨyuxeɨriekai kaniwarumini xeimiriyari tuurutsixi meta 'atahuta miriyari muxatsi, metatsiere Kuratsie kiekatari wa'ukiyarima mekaniwarumini, xeimiriyari tuurutsixi meta tamamata miriyari muxatsi. Hikɨ yumɨiretɨ tawari mawari wewiwamete mekaniyu'itieni.

Yunaitɨ teɨteri Kuratsie memɨyuxeɨriekai mekaniyutemamawiekaitɨni, yaxeikɨata mawari wewiwamete, rewitsixi meta 'Ixaheri kwieyaritsie memeyekɨ, tewanarixi 'ixɨararipa memu'axɨa, metatsiere Kura kwieyaritsie kiekatari.
Kepauka paitɨtɨ 'amuyeikakai Tsarumuni, Rawiri nu'aya, 'Ixaheritsie ti'aitame, Kerutsaremetsie pɨkawewiyawekai 'ixɨarari mɨpaɨ titemawierimatɨ.

Hikɨ 'arike rewitsixi meta mawari wewiwamete 'ameti'uka Kakaɨyari mekaniutawawirieni teɨteri 'aixɨa mɨwayurienikɨ, hikɨ Yawé kaniwaru'enieni, wanenewieri muyuawitsie paitɨ kaniu'enieni, muyepatsietsie paitɨ Kakaɨyari muwayeka.
